description.value: Chatime is a globally recognised bubble tea franchise with over 1,300 outlets worldwide, specialising in freshly brewed milk teas, fruit teas, smoothies, and signature boba drinks. This Hastings Street location operates as a takeout-focused shop offering a wide range of cold and warm beverages. Cyclists passing through the area could stop for a quick, customisable drink.
